title: Rain‑Whispered Wishes
description:
A restless, sky‑dreaming girl named Mira discovers that every storm she steps into writes a new page in her life’s story—one that fizzes with hidden ability, unexpected allies, and secrets soaked in the heart of an ancient forest. When a high‑level researcher arrives with a proposal to harness the forest’s rain as a clean‑energy weapon, Mira must decide whether to protect the delicate flooding magic that brings her rhythm and peace, or grant the researchers society’s next leap. The turmoil she faces is mirrored by the relentless, dynamic weather patterns of her town, pushing Mira to become the guardian of the rain’s spirit. In doing so, she finds her own strength and learns that the true source of her power comes from the unappreciated ways the world beats in sync with her voice.

Through shifting landscapes that twist like meteoric clouds and people who crave more than just a safe life, Mira’s journey transforms into a quest to safeguard the fragile dance between earthly moisture and human ambition, proving that sometimes the most passionately adored storms carry the seeds of survival and wonder.
